notifications.email_subject: CRITICAL SUPPLY CHAIN ADVISORY: Revised Delivery Schedule for Order #{order_id}
notifications.email_body:
Dear {customer_name},

We are writing to inform you of an operational routing adjustment affecting order #{order_id} ({sku_name}). Due to {disruption_reason}, the revised expected delivery date is {revised_delivery_date} (delay of approximately {delay_days} business days).

Our autonomous mitigation engine has secured priority freight to minimize further exposure.

Sincerely,
Rimberio Supply Chain Operations
notifications.sms_body: Rimberio Notice: Order #{order_id} has a revised ETA of {revised_delivery_date} due to {disruption_reason}.
